payload.title: Connect explicit task locators to existing native grounding and source acquisition
payload.summary: Priority2 bounded RI-to-agent integration. U2 exact_hint_routing and U3 mechanism_routing compose trusted authored exact hints with maintained ground_task_anchor and no-loss lexical fallback. Native ContextTools lookup_symbol only searches source-view qualified names; no caller-authored task locator/obligation bridge consumes module/direct-declaration/method grounding outcomes. Add one opt-in application composition over existing owners, not another planner, parser, locator hierarchy or ranking policy. Existing Localization witness proposal15bae0a6 remains the broader semantic-decision obligation; this capability ends at source acquisition.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: trusted caller supplies explicit bounded existing-resource/module/qualified-declaration or direct-method locators with task/need provenance; actual ToolRunner result preserves native current frame/candidate identities and all ambiguity/unsupported/unresolved cases. Unique grounded source is acquired through current observation/read owner before an exact edit; map/hint metadata alone never authorizes editing. Preserve authorized scope, full lexical escape and unchanged global task objective; do not route introduce-new or conceptual text as proof existing source is required. Demonstrate positive and negative native scripted sequence locator-to-source-to-admitted edit-to-check_changes PASS-to-host is_current and restoration staleness; record actual model use and controlled effectiveness only in separately authorized work. Include repeated names, multiple roots, absent/new files, stale/forged frames, Unicode/CRLF and over-budget disclosure. Maintenance-agent suitable after scoped owner/contract qualification.
payload.uncertainty: Public input presentation and ownership of caller-authored associations require review. U3 fixed prefixes are experimental grammar, not general intent inference. No model effectiveness or timing claim; no automatic policy promotion. Preserve current atomic limits and no source/approval authority expansion.
